I am writing to apply for the Backend Engineer, Ledger position at Larkspur Payments. My background includes six years as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, where I owned the order-routing service—a high-volume system handling approximately 2 million events per day using TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL. I also served as an engineering lead at Vertex Logistics for two years, managing a team of five across the dispatch and billing product lines.

A key achievement was leading a nine-month strangler-fig migration from a monolith to event-driven services, achieving zero customer-visible downtime and reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds. This experience demonstrates my ability to modernize critical systems while maintaining reliability, which is essential for a ledger-focused role. I also have substantial experience with PostgreSQL schema design, query tuning, and logical replication, as well as deploying services with Kubernetes and Terraform.

My technical skills in TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, combined with my experience in event-driven architecture and team leadership, align well with the demands of the Backend Engineer, Ledger role. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background can contribute to Larkspur Payments.
